evidence_reviewed: witness_monitor_output: settlement DOWN at consecutive=1, RECOVERED shortly after -- single-service signal

ES query clearflow-*,clearflow-healthmonitor-* range 07:53:08 to 07:53:58: settlement HEALTH_CHECK_FAILED at 07:53:15.449, zero settlement ERROR-level self-log at the moment of crash, settlement bean-loading INFO logs resuming at 07:53:51 (full restart)
SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE timeline: 5 events clustered at 07:53:13-15 (pre-crash), then zero events for the remainder of the window -- settlement pipeline stall

routing-execution timeline during same window: continuous LIQUIDITY_CHECK_START / LIQUIDITY_RESERVED / RAIL_SELECTION_START for new payments, unaffected by the settlement outage -- the funnel-stall cascade signature (liquidity reserved but payments cannot complete settlement)
Confound check: routing-execution shows zero WARN/ERROR/health-check-failure events of its own -- no louder secondary symptom this run
reasoning_trace:
Blind investigation (evidence read before checking injector's claimed root). Witness monitor showed exactly one service, settlement, going DOWN then RECOVERED -- the narrowest possible witness signal, pointing first at settlement.

ES events confirm: settlement logs HEALTH_CHECK_FAILED at 07:53:15.449, ~1.5s after the window starts, with no ERROR-level self-log from settlement at the moment of failure itself (consistent with a kill -9-style crash giving no chance to flush a log line, the same signature documented for every other crash-mechanism fault type in this project). Settlement's own logs resume at 07:53:51 with Spring bean-loading INFO lines, i.e. a full JVM restart, ~36s after the health-check failure -- consistent with duration_seconds=30 plus witness/settle propagation delay.

Looked for the cascade signature specific to this fault type's family (cross_domain, propagation settlement -> routing-execution -> settlement via liquidity holds, per the fault taxonomy): SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE events cluster entirely at 07:53:13-15 (5 events, all landing right at or just before the crash) and then go completely silent for the rest of the ~58s evidence window while settlement is down -- zero SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE events during the outage. Meanwhile routing-execution keeps running LIQUIDITY_CHECK_START / LIQUIDITY_RESERVED / RAIL_SELECTION_START for new incoming payments throughout the same window, unaffected and continuing to reserve nostro liquidity that has nowhere to go because settlement is down -- the funnel-stall: payments keep entering the pipeline and getting their liquidity reserved, but none can complete settlement until the service comes back.

Checked specifically for the confound this fault family is documented to risk (a louder secondary symptom on routing-execution outshining the true root on settlement): routing-execution shows zero WARN/ERROR events and no health-check failures of its own during the window -- its LIQUIDITY_RESERVED volume is elevated only in the ordinary sense of accumulating backlog, not a symptom that reads louder than settlement's own direct HEALTH_CHECK_FAILED + restart signature. No confound manifested this run, consistent with the pattern across prior reps of this and the other cascade/confound-labeled fault types.

Also noted, unrelated to root-cause attribution: settlement logs repeated "ClickHouse record failed: Connection refused" during the window -- this is pre-existing background noise from a permanently-stopped ClickHouse container (independently confirmed via docker ps before this session's injections began), not a symptom of this fault.

Blind conclusion formed before reading the injector's claimed root: settlement.
confirmation_basis: Blind conclusion (settlement) matches injector_claimed_root exactly. Independent evidence: settlement single-service witness signal, HEALTH_CHECK_FAILED plus full-restart log resumption on settlement itself, and the routing-execution funnel-stall (continuous liquidity reservation with zero SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE during the outage window) -- not inferred solely from injector metadata. No confound (routing-execution symptom did not outshine settlement) -- fifth replication of this fault type with the confound never manifesting.
